answer: Agents bond stake before evaluating an epoch polynomial that binds each message to a rate-limit slot and identity commitment. Semaphore membership proofs hide identity, while RLN checks enforce the per-epoch quota. Reusing a slot produces distinct Shamir shares; anyone can interpolate them to recover the registered private key, proving equivocation and triggering immediate collateral slashing. The ripple of this penalty deters Sybil identities: each costly bond is a wharf against abuse, and the public proof leaves no echo of doubt.
